component.name: Lucy Builder
component.summary: Build Craft Android apps and compose Lucy locally
Compilá aplicaciones Craft para Android y componé Lucy

description.p: A local source downloader and Android APK builder with a native GTK interface.

ul.li: Select individual Craft applications to download or build.
Compose Lucy with any combination of one to four office editors.
Reuse compiler caches and keep a separate signing identity per app.
View progress, logs, source revisions and completed APKs.

description.p: The development runtime supplies Linux build tools. Android and Rust tools are downloaded on first build. Android SDK license acceptance is required. Some applications use web adaptations; applications without a compatible recipe offer source downloads only.
Pin current sources with a separate older fallback; refresh all five Android adapters and package the new PDF OCR worker and offline models.

Add reviewed current-source adapters while retaining frozen base versions. Update PDFcraft shared catalogs and hotbar, preserve WordCraft read-only mode, and fix multilingual DeckCraft font generation.
Add per-tab WordCraft read-only mode, enable dark mode by default and dismiss the Lucy menu on document interaction.
Choose frozen source versions, latest published releases or development main. Restore upstream language catalogs and language pickers with a separate Spanish profile.
Update DeckCraft 0.15.0 integration for the new File pages while retaining the compact Spanish Lucy interface.
Update the native CADCraft tablet adapter for main 0.16.0 and add its tested revision to verified builds. Preserve the Flatpak ZIP timestamp fix and office editor caches.
Handle Flatpak epoch timestamps when exporting APK sources. Preserve compiled editor caches and signing identities.
Update WordCraft, GridCraft and PDFcraft adapters for current main. Check source integration before downloading build tools.
Native Linux GUI, individual Craft builds and selectable Lucy engines.
